Aircraft for testing
new technology.

Veylan builds reusable uncrewed test aircraft for sensor manufacturers, aerospace development teams and research organisations. Our offer combines Sable with equipment integration support and test preparation.

Engineering doesn’t
end at takeoff.

An aircraft needs to do more than fly. It needs to be understood, inspected and supported by the people working with it.

That is the idea behind Veylan. Aircraft design and systems development belong in the same conversation as maintenance, integration and the next day’s work in the hangar.

By looking at the complete development cycle, we can ask better questions at the start of a programme—and make each test more useful.

A practical approach
to ambitious work.

Design for access

The people who integrate, inspect and service a platform should have a voice in how it is designed. Maintainability starts before the first part is made.

Make the test count

Begin with a clear engineering question. Define what needs to be observed and how the results will guide the next decision.

Consider the whole system

Aircraft, onboard equipment, software and ground processes depend on one another. Evaluate them together rather than treating integration as an afterthought.

Leave room to change

Development programmes evolve. A platform should make configuration changes understandable and give teams a way to build on what they have learned.

Meet the platform
behind the approach.

Sable gives your team an aircraft to carry test equipment, recover it after flight and prepare a revised configuration.
